import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

COLOR_KL = '#0072B2'
COLOR_TEAL = '#E69F00'

# K-curve data: K values and PPL (3-seed mean ± std where available)
K = [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32]
# PPL means — K=16 placeholder (s42 only), update when 3-seed arrives
ppl_mean = [9.05, 10.75, 8.89, 8.99, 8.67, 8.81]
# Std: 0 means single-seed (no error bar)
ppl_std =  [0.0,  0.16,  0.01, 0.06, 0.0,  0.02]
# Which points are 3-seed
is_3seed = [False, True,  True, True, False, True]

TEAL_PPL = 10.82

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 3.0))

x_pos = np.arange(len(K))

for i, (k, m, s, multi) in enumerate(zip(K, ppl_mean, ppl_std, is_3seed)):
    marker = 'o' if multi else 's'
    eb = ax.errorbar(x_pos[i], m, yerr=s if s > 0 else None,
                     fmt=marker, color=COLOR_KL, markersize=7,
                     capsize=4, capthick=1.5, elinewidth=1.5,
                     markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8,
                     zorder=5)

ax.plot(x_pos, ppl_mean, '-', color=COLOR_KL, alpha=0.5, zorder=3)

ax.axhline(y=TEAL_PPL, color=COLOR_TEAL, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2,
           alpha=0.8, zorder=2)
ax.text(x_pos[-1] + 0.15, TEAL_PPL + 0.05, 'TEAL', color=COLOR_TEAL,
        fontsize=9, va='bottom', ha='left')

ax.annotate(f'K=2: {ppl_mean[1]:.2f}',
            xy=(x_pos[1], ppl_mean[1]),
            xytext=(x_pos[1] + 0.4, ppl_mean[1] + 0.15),
            fontsize=8, color='#555555',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', lw=0.8))

best_idx = np.argmin(ppl_mean)
ax.annotate(f'K={K[best_idx]}: {ppl_mean[best_idx]:.2f}',
            xy=(x_pos[best_idx], ppl_mean[best_idx]),
            xytext=(x_pos[best_idx] - 0.6, ppl_mean[best_idx] - 0.35),
            fontsize=8, color='#555555',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', lw=0.8))

ax.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax.set_xticklabels([str(k) for k in K])
ax.set_xlabel('Coupling breadth $K$ (layers per step)')
ax.set_ylabel('Perplexity (WikiText-2)')

ax.set_ylim(8.0, 11.5)

from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color=COLOR_KL, label='3-seed mean$\\pm$std',
           markersize=6, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='s', color=COLOR_KL, label='Single seed (s42)',
           markersize=6, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5),
    Line2D([0], [0], color=COLOR_TEAL, linestyle='--', label='TEAL baseline'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right', frameon=True,
          fancybox=False, edgecolor='#cccccc')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('figures/paper/k_curve_ppl.pdf')
plt.savefig('figures/paper/k_curve_ppl.png')
print('Saved k_curve_ppl.pdf and k_curve_ppl.png')
